gap: No result ChatGPT got states that VIOFO's days-long 'Hybrid Parking' (it drops to Low Power Impact Detection at 0.24 W / 20 mA at 12 V) is documented only for the HK6 kit on A329S-series cameras, while the HK4 kit that fits ChatGPT's A229 Plus and A229 Pro unlocks buffered Auto Event Detection but cannot switch modes by battery voltage.
standout_why: I read Dashlore (cited). It says the A229-family cameras need 'an HK4 or HK6 kit', with the kit not included, and that every buffered camera needs a hardwire kit, OBD-II cable or battery pack. It treats HK4 and HK6 as interchangeable. It gives no parking power draw, no runtime and no cutoff voltages, and it does not say that HK6 hybrid/low-power switching is tied to the A329S series. ChatGPT's own answer calls the hardwire kit 'optional' for the A229 Plus. Technobezz (cited) returned HTTP 403 and the YouTube video (cited) was not readable, so I could not check whether either one covers this. That is why I scored 2 and not 3.
kit_items: Dash cam: VIOFO A229 Pro 2CH (4K front + 2K rear, ChatGPT's 'pick for most drivers'). VIOFO's store page says buffered Auto Event Detection (saves 15 s before impact) works only with the HK4 hardwire kit, sold separately.

Hardwire kit: VIOFO HK4 Type-C, 4 m. VIOFO lists it for the A119 MINI 2, A229 Plus, A229 Pro, A229 Ultra, A329, T130 and WM1. Without it the A229 has no parking mode once the 12 V socket switches off.

Fuse taps: the Amazon A229 Pro + HK4 bundle includes 8 fuse taps. VIOFO's 6 m HK4 listing says fuse taps are not included, so match the type to the car's fuse box (ATO, Mini, Micro2 or Mini Low Profile).

Do not swap in the VIOFO HK6 ($25.99) expecting low-power mode on an A229. VIOFO's HK6 copy and blog tie Hybrid Parking and Low Power Impact Detection to the A329S series (A329S/A329T/A329WW). A shopper who wants days of parking coverage should buy an A329S plus HK6 instead.

Same-store alternative from an approved program: DDPAI N5 Pro (4K + 2K, 64 GB eMMC) with the DDPAI Hardwire Kit with Fuse Tap, which DDPAI lists for all DDPAI dash cams except the Z100 Master. DDPAI also sells an OBD Intelligent Hardwire Kit for drivers who don't want to tap a fuse.
microSD card: high-endurance card. I did not source or price a specific model.
